protocol: Three rounds, disjoint complete parent recordings: development, second validation with tuning, final frozen holdout. No model outcomes from a later round are read when selecting an earlier version.
native_fps_check: Final selected version only, on the two reserved round-3 recordings
selection: Highest mean HOTA across the person and vehicle recording, subject to earlier fixture/standing-person/motorcycle regression checks; IDF1 breaks ties. Prefer the incumbent within 0.01 HOTA points.
round_3_comparison: Frozen selected version and the predeclared original retail baseline at 5 FPS. No holdout-driven tuning; only the selected version receives the additional native-FPS check.

limitations: Released labeled training sequences used as local holdouts; not the official hidden test set.
Local source-sequence exclusion does not prove that pretrained YOLO never saw benchmark imagery.
Vehicle footage is a road benchmark, not supermarket-parking-lot validation; XML marks these cameras unstable.
MOT17 pedestrian ignore rules are applied using the pinned official TrackEval code.

UA-DETRAC car/bus/van/others are one vehicle group. Unmatched predictions with >=50% area in the union of published ignored regions are excluded. These are custom subset HOTA/CLEAR/ID scores, not official UA-DETRAC PR-MOTA rankings.

Reference crossings are independently derived from human-labeled trajectories, not dataset-provided doorway-event labels. Ambiguous low-visibility/overlap references are flagged and excluded from event scoring.
Counting lines were chosen from source images before model outcomes. They are illustrative image boundaries, not actual property-entry labels.
